mainEntity.name: Can I install trim and molding myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While DIY installation is possible, hiring a professional ensures precision, efficiency, and a high-quality finish, especially for complex profiles like crown molding or intricate historical reproductions. Professionals have specialized tools and experience in achieving tight miter joints and smooth transitions. Incorrect cuts or poor installation can lead to visible gaps and an unprofessional appearance, requiring more costly fixes later. Frasheski Construction offers expertise for flawless results in the Berkeley and East Bay areas.
